evidence.claim: A hung fixture (frozen heartbeat AND frozen output bytes) is classified STALLED in 0.30293497999991814s (stall_window_s=0.28), which is less than catalog timeout_seconds=2700 and less than the probe hard timeout_s=4.0. Classification requires two dead signals; slot_released is true.

A slow-but-alive fixture with frozen heartbeat and growing bytes is ALIVE (byte_growth=True, heartbeat_advanced=False). Removing the byte-growth signal (classify_heartbeat_only_defective) classifies the same samples STALLED (STALLED), so the slow-alive test goes red.
Adversarial attempts to classify a live slow unit as STALLED failed (0 stalls). mtime-only classification is rejected. A hung negative control remains STALLED, so the detector is not inert.
